bit_order: walk = one natural number read LSB-first (k-th bit read = bit pos+k, as rdw/WIN). Raw fixed-width fields: value LSB first. Prefix codewords: MSB first (first codeword bit at the lowest position). Canonical: symbols sorted by (length, symbol); first[1] = 0, first[l+1] = (first[l] + count[l]) << 1; decode code = 2*code + bit until code - first[l] < count[l].
escape: each code has ESC = alphabet size (pseudo-count 1); ESC is followed by the symbol as a raw field of raw_bits bits (value LSB first)
leaf_layout: M leaf: [0][0]; with A: for q = 0..16: [A(q)] [fields of term 2q] [fields of term 2q+1]; without A: per term [kappa 2][fields]; fields of term t with kind k: [j1: B(t,1) or 7 raw, if k >= 1][j2: B(t,2) or 7 raw, if k = 3][lambda: C(k) or 10 raw, if k >= 2]; then multipliers [1][c 5][side 1][Yq 13] closed by [0]. Splits [1][axis 6][mode 1] and reflected leaves [0] unchanged.

A.what: kinds of terms 2q and 2q+1 jointly, symbol 4*kappa_a + kappa_b

B.what: point code jj of term t (index into terms), slot 1 = j1, 2 = j2
